page.notes: The page is a scan with heavy specks and ink damage on both columns. The Hebrew letters, especially the vowel points and the root letters after the Latin glosses, are doubtful in several places. The running head letters are unclear. Entry 5 and the Rad. abbreviations may be misprinted or partly misread. The hyphenated splits (teg-en, castiga-tio, vin-culum, casti-gavit) follow the line breaks as I read them. Several Hebrew forms are uncertain and should be checked against the scan.
